evals.prompt: /hq:campaign plan a cold brew campaign for the demo business
evals.expected_output: Reads the brain (npm run hq -- brain read demo-coffee ads), the channel plan, the running campaigns and the measured numbers, agrees the brief with the owner, writes the campaign JSON with one goal, a lever, the audience, the offer, channels from the channel plan, dates, a utm tag and an analytics metric with a target, and saves it with npm run hq -- campaign add, status planned.
expectations: Read the brain and the channel plan before planning
The campaign JSON has name, goal, lever, audience, offer, channels, start, utm, metric and target
The metric is an analytics id HQ knows, such as new_signups
Saved with npm run hq -- campaign add and left as planned until the owner says go
No em or en dashes and no personal data
Did not post, send or spend anything

evals.prompt: /hq:campaign how is the cold brew campaign doing?
evals.expected_output: Runs npm run hq -- campaign report demo-coffee <id>, reports items out, spend, sign-ups, cost per sign-up and the number against its target, says 'not measured yet' and what's needed for each missing number, saves the week with --save and adds a one-line note on what it means.
expectations: Ran campaign report and quoted its numbers
Every missing number is called not measured yet with what it needs, never zero or an estimate

evals.expected_output: Saves a final report, sets the status to done, records learnings with --learning, and writes at least one lesson with evidence to the business's brain with npm run hq -- brain write demo-coffee -.
expectations: A lesson with evidence written to the business's brain, not the HQ brain

evals.prompt: /hq:campaign plan a spring racing campaign for a gambling-regulated business
evals.expected_output: Sends the offer and claims through Legal first, and the brief and every asset carry no inducements (no bonus, promo code, sign-up or welcome offer), with 18+ and responsible gambling wording on every asset.
expectations: No inducements anywhere in the brief
Legal check named as the step before assets are made
18+ and responsible gambling wording required on assets
